purpose: Fresh-rollout coding RL: test whether sequential audits earn their complexity over whole-group correction

data.final_test: all official validation tasks, sealed until confirmation
data.reference: AND over union of original public and hidden tests, deterministic seeded runner
data.proxy_feedback: public tests only; no hidden feedback is sent to actor
data.certificate: any public-test failure certifies union-reference failure; available to every method

rollout.early_stop: public tests all pass or maximum turns reached
rollout.question_format: fixed code-only Python instruction, original task, previous program and agent-visible public feedback

optimizer.audit_time: immediately before each optimizer step, fresh independent audit randomness
optimizer.coefficient_plumbing: direct sign-separated linear combination; no renormalization or sign reclamping
optimizer.loss_mask: all generated assistant tokens including code; user/tool tokens excluded
optimizer.long_context_rule: deterministic declared rolling context; log every truncation

audit.order: pre-audit decreasing p*(1-p), stable record-id tie break
audit.schedule: fixed-order model-moment PAVA using unit query costs
audit.predictor_features: pre-audit code/trajectory and public-test features only
audit.known_labels: retain prior exact cached verdicts, charge only distinct reference computations
audit.calibration_cost_amortization: actual stated deployment groups only, never infinite or omitted

baseline_definitions.whole_group_residual: same learned proxy, exact completion, certificates and expected unknown-label count as SC
baseline_definitions.full_group_small_batch: select complete groups before generation, generate and fully verify fewer groups; report different rollout/update counts as an alternative compute pipeline
baseline_definitions.pgbc_fixed_scale: Cai v4 direct coefficients, leave-one-out baseline, fixed scale; estimated effective channel, no current-group z-score; includes calibration/appeal costs

pgbc_details.cheap_binary_verdict: all public tests passed on final program
pgbc_details.channel_estimation: calibration-only class-conditional empirical rates; exact false-negative rate zero under union-test semantics
pgbc_details.poor_channel_rule: stop and report this baseline as unidentified/unstable if calibration lacks either reference class or 1-false_positive-false_negative < 0.05; do not silently replace or clamp the channel

evaluation.checkpoints: fixed 0%, 50%, 100% collection count, plus cost ledger
evaluation.primary_comparison: SC versus WG heldout reference success and measured cost frontier
evaluation.diagnostic_full_label_banks: 16 task groups at initial/end checkpoints for a predeclared diagnostic seed; separate accounting and no optimizer access
evaluation.seed_uncertainty: paired across fixed training seeds; task-level paired bootstrap separately; no trajectory pseudo-replication
evaluation.insufficient_power: report intervals, never call overlap equivalence

sandbox.cache_key: task, program, image, tests, limits and seed hashes

ledger.overlap_rule: end-to-end time comes from actual interval timestamps; do not sum overlapping GPU/CPU components as wall time
